description: Runs cargo test and returns structured test results (name, status, pass/fail counts).

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

noFailFast.description: Run all tests regardless of failures (--no-fail-fast)

noRun.description: Compile tests but do not run them (--no-run)

package.description: Package to test in a workspace (-p <SPEC>)

release.description: Test in release mode with optimizations (--release)

testArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the test harness (after --). Example: ['--test-threads=1', '--nocapture', '--ignored', '--include-ignored', '--exact']

name: test

compilationDiagnostics.description: Compiler diagnostics from --message-format=json when tests fail to compile

suggestion.description: Suggested fix text from compiler/clippy children

title: Cargo Test
